project.mainline: 打造自己的 AI 私人助理，让日程、资料和待办事项在日常生活中衔接起来。

stage_mainlines.明确需求: 找出日常最需要帮助的事情，确定首版助理的能力范围。
stage_mainlines.整理资料: 整理必要的个人资料和偏好，明确可访问的信息范围。
stage_mainlines.打通任务: 让助理能够协助安排日程、查找资料和跟进事项。
stage_mainlines.真实试用: 把已完成的能力放进日常生活，检验是否省心可靠。
stage_mainlines.稳定使用: 解决试用中的关键问题，形成可以持续使用的个人助理。

stage_mainlines.日程安排: 整理时间安排，及时发现冲突和需要确认的事项。
stage_mainlines.资料查找: 从自己的资料中找到答案，并能回到原文核对。
stage_mainlines.事项跟进: 把约定和待办接续起来，清楚知道下一步要做什么。

stage_details.资料查找: 支持按问题查找笔记与文档，回答时附上对应出处。

branches.name: 云端接入
branches.mainline: 接入已有云端服务，让日程、资料和待办尽快协同起来。

stage_mainlines.连接服务: 连接已有日历、笔记和待办服务。
stage_mainlines.串起任务: 让会议安排、相关资料和后续待办衔接起来。
stage_mainlines.核对权限: 确认每项服务能访问什么，重要操作由本人确认。
stage_mainlines.日常试用: 用真实日程检验服务连接是否稳定、是否省心。

stage_details.串起任务: 先从日历读取会议，再找出相关资料，最后生成会后待办。

branches.name: 本地运行
branches.mainline: 让助理在本机处理个人资料，并能在离线时完成常用任务。

stage_mainlines.整理本地资料: 整理可供助理使用的本地笔记和文档。
stage_mainlines.本地检索: 从本地资料找到答案，并准确指向原文。
stage_mainlines.离线任务: 在断网时完成资料查询和待办整理。
stage_mainlines.日常试用: 确认本地助理在常用设备上足够快、足够可靠。

stage_details.本地检索: 已经能找到相关文档，正在修复回答引用跳错段落的问题。

project.mainline: Build a personal AI assistant that connects your calendar, knowledge, and everyday tasks.

stage_mainlines.Define needs: Choose the everyday tasks where an assistant would help most.
stage_mainlines.Gather context: Organize personal information and decide what the assistant may access.
stage_mainlines.Connect tasks: Help with scheduling, finding information, and following up.
stage_mainlines.Try it daily: Use the working parts in daily life and see whether they save effort.
stage_mainlines.Keep it useful: Resolve the problems that matter and make the assistant reliable over time.

stage_mainlines.Scheduling: Keep plans organized and flag conflicts that need attention.
stage_mainlines.Find answers: Find answers in personal documents and link back to the original source.
stage_mainlines.Follow up: Connect commitments and tasks so the next step is clear.

stage_details.Find answers: Search notes and documents by question, with sources attached to each answer.

branches.name: Cloud services
branches.mainline: Connect existing cloud services to bring calendars, documents, and tasks together quickly.

stage_mainlines.Connect services: Connect existing calendar, notes, and task services.
stage_mainlines.Link tasks: Connect meetings with relevant documents and follow-up tasks.
stage_mainlines.Check access: Check what each service can access and require approval for important actions.
stage_mainlines.Try it daily: Use real plans to check whether service connections are reliable and useful.

stage_details.Link tasks: Read a meeting from the calendar, find relevant documents, then draft follow-up tasks.

branches.name: Local processing
branches.mainline: Keep personal information on your device and make everyday tasks work offline.

stage_mainlines.Organize files: Organize the local notes and documents available to the assistant.
stage_mainlines.Local search: Find answers in local documents and point to the right source passage.
stage_mainlines.Offline tasks: Find information and organize tasks without an internet connection.
stage_mainlines.Try it daily: Check that the local assistant is fast and reliable on everyday devices.

stage_details.Local search: Relevant documents can already be found. Fixing source links that open the wrong passage.
